Description - GET /{accountName}/{folderName}/{subfolderName}/{fileName}

Public web page of a file: the folder page URL (see openPublicFolderPage) plus /<name>,<fileId>.<ext>, i.e. the file name with its numeric file id inserted before the extension after a comma (probe,10833170275.txt for file id 10833170275; Observed). The client does not request these pages itself (they are not among its web URL templates); they were fetched anonymously (no session, no cookie) in the live follow-up to look for a visible effect of ModifyFolder description, freePoints and freeTransfer. Observed: HTTP 200, and none of the three fields appears: neither the description marker nor any free-transfer or points wording (word counts in the meta files, equal before and after the change). Only status and headers were recorded; the body digest is kept in each capture. With one field set at a time (run D) the file page differed from the baseline only by the noise seen between two fetches of the unchanged page: 33 tokens (verification tokens, a signed avatar URL, ad banners, a rotating list of other files of the account), none mentioning the field or its value.

Path template. OAS path templates cannot span a variable number of segments, so the template shows the depth used in the captures (a folder two levels below the account root); other depths follow the same globalId pattern.
